==Historical Background==
In Greek mythology, Callisto was a nymph of Artemis who took a vow to remain a virgin, as did all the nymphs of Artemis. But to have her, Zeus disguised himself, according to ''Ovid'', as Artemis herself in order to lure her into his embrace and rape her. While Callisto was bathing it was discovered that she was pregnant and then turned into a bear to later give birth to her son Arcas.  Callisto is also a moon of the planet Jupiter, discovered in 1610 by Galileo Galilei.  It is the third-largest moon in the Solar System and the second largest in the Jovian system, after Ganymede.

[[Category:Terminology]][[Category:NPCs]][[de:Kampagnenaufseher]]
[[Campaign Arbiter]]s can usually be found near a zone's fortification or in a nation's capital.  They are responsible for issuing [[Allied Tags]] for participation in [[:Category:Campaign Battles|Campaign Battles]], selling [[:Category:Campaign Battles|Campaign]] specific temporary items, Teleporting, and giving basic information on Campaign Battles.  Allied Tags and Temporary Items are only able to be issued/sold during a Campaign Battle.


Campaign Arbiters provide the following services:
*Teleportation
*General information on Campaign Battles.

Additionally, while a Campaign battle is underway in a zone, its Campaign Arbiter will provide:
*Issuing of [[Allied Tags]]
*Registration to a [[Unions |Union]] when in possession of Allied Tags.
*Provide battle assessment ([[Experience Points]] and [[Allied Notes]] prior to the ending of the current Campaign Battle).
*If the zone is under the control of the Allied Forces, a Campaign Arbiter will provide [[:Category:Campaign Battles#Temporary Items| Temporary Items]].
**Note: If the zone has 0 resources, Campaign Temporary Items will be unavailable.

[[Category:Summoning Magic]][[Category:Avatars]][[category:Cutscene NPCs]] {{disambig3|the summoning magic spell [[Carbuncle]], or [[Carbuncle (Disambiguation)|another page with this name]]}} {{NPC | image = Smn_carbuncle.jpg | model = | name = | gender = | race = | bestiary = Avatar | job = White Mage | affiliation = Outland | occupation = Bringer of Rainbows | status = | type = Cutscene NPC/Summoned Avatar | location = | starts missions = | starts quests = *[[The Puppet Master|SMN AF1: The Puppet Master]] *[[Class Reunion|SMN AF2: Class Reunion]] *[[Carbuncle Debacle|SMN AF3: Carbuncle Debacle]] *[[Waking the Beast]] | involved in missions = *[[Promathia Mission 5-3|Promathia Mission 5-3: Three Paths]] :*[[Promathia Mission 5-3/Tenzen Path|The Pursuit of Paradise (Tenzen's Path)]] | involved in quests = *[[I Can Hear a Rainbow]] *[[The Moonlit Path]] *[[Waking Dreams]] *[[The Long March North]] *[[The Forbidden Path]] | notes = | historicalbackground = }} == Avatar Information == A mysterious ruby that is said to bring good fortune to its bearer. Takes the form of a small, furry creature that leads the [[summoner]] to the other [[avatars]]. The ability to summon Carbuncle is one of the basic [[summoner]] abilities, and is available from level 1 as soon as the job is unlocked from the quest [[I Can Hear a Rainbow]] (which is centered around summoning Carbuncle from his ruby). [[Carbuncle Prime]], a very powerful monster, can be fought at the end of the [[Waking the Beast]] quest. == Other Information == *Many arguments over what type of animal Carbuncle is have led to a Japanese flying blue squirrel known as a [http://www.momonga.org Momonga]. Carbuncle, originally was spelled "carbunkel", a magical creature reported in the Americas by early Spanish. They are described as small creatures, with a certain gem on their foreheads. The gems come from the brains of dragons. According to myth, dragons have inside their brain a liquid that crystallizes into a solid gem when they die. According to superstition, it is good luck to catch a carbuncle. *It is safe to assume that the name Carbuncle comes from the latin Carbuncŭlus, which means ruby. *In the tropical America, there is an insect called Carbúnculo, most popularly known as Carbunclo or Cocuyo (dusk star). It is a coleopteran insect; its body is about three centimeters long, oblong shaped, brown and with two yellowish spots to the sides of the thorax, from which it emanates a very bright azure light. === Quotes === '''''"Vana'diel is the world in which you live. You should see the true Vana'diel with your own eyes."'''''
'''''"I will extend a bridge...between the people of the present, and beings of ages past."'''''
--Carbuncle, during ''I Can Hear a Rainbow'' === See Also === * [[Conversations with a Ruby]] * [[Waking the Beast]]
